title: A cloud merge's install does not move the live pin by cloud mode
why: Debt cloud-merge-moves-live-pin (coordinator, Oct 31 19:34 CDT): each cloud merge runs `bash <pin>/install.sh` with CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true, so cloud mode moves the pin, not merge/install_from_main.sh. Ruling 4 of decision merge-reinstalls-from-main: only that script moves the pinned checkout.
note: Likely in normal work: every cloud merge runs it. Fix the cause in one home: the merge's after-step runs the install so that only install_from_main.sh moves the pin, or install.sh's cloud mode leaves a pin it was not asked to move. Done check: a test runs the after-merge install with CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true and the pin moves only through install_from_main.sh's one rename, red on main and green on the fix. Closes debt cloud-merge-moves-live-pin. Needs no answer. Files: merge/install_from_main.sh, hooks/install.sh, merge/test_merge.py or hooks/test_cloud_setup.sh. Linked: step setup-leaves-pin-cwd (#915) touches hooks/install.sh too, so it starts after #915 merges.
